Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chk_all number :=0;
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date varchar2(20);
BEGIN

 :exist_inter_blk.transaction_id :=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id;

 If :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id is not null then --only if the donation is selected [does not apply for deferral]
 GET_FINAL_UNIT(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,szUnitId);
 :exist_inter_blk.unit_id := szUnitId;
 End if;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := to_char(v_local_time,'mm/dd/yyyy');
 else
 v_local_date := to_char(sysdate,'mm/dd/yyyy');
 end if; 
 
 /* Check whether the user has ALL access level */
 
 begin
 select distinct 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 and access_code_value ='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm/dd/yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')+1))
 and to_date(v_local_date,'mm/dd/yyyy') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(v_local_date,'mm/dd/yyyy')+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if chk_all = 1 then
 
 set_block_property('exist_inter_blk',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and ' ||'to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') between trunc(insert_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),' ||'to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') +1)
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''INTUD'')');
 else
 -- set the default where . Inter type should not be DR ( property ) and the
 -- interdiction should be effective 
 set_block_property('exist_inter_blk',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and inter_code in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type=''INTER''
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and ' ||'to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'')between eff_date and nvl(term_date,' ||'to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) )
 and ' ||'to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'') between trunc(insert_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),' ||'to_date(' ||''''||v_local_date||''''||',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+1)
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''INTUD'')');
 
 end if;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 descr varchar2(50);
 cursor c1 is
 select inter_code,
 inter_type,
 insert_date,
 term_date,
 insert_user,
 release_user,
 originated_from,
 reason_code,
 group_mode,
 group_id
 from donation_interdictions
 where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and inter_code in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) )
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and trunc(term_date)<trunc(sysdate)
 order by insert_date desc ;
 

begin

 /* set insert allowed * delete allowed properties true to enable to
 insert the data */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 go_block('term_inter_blk');

 /* populate the block with terminated interdicions */

 for z in c1
 loop
 select inter_desc
 into descr
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=z.inter_code; 
 
 :term_inter_blk.inter_code := z.inter_code;
 :term_inter_blk.descrip := descr;
 :term_inter_blk.inter_type:=z.inter_type;
 :term_inter_blk.eff_date := to_char(z.insert_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 :term_inter_blk.term_date := to_char(z.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');

PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_old (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM ( p_exec_name);
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS
BEGIN
Declare
 c_proc_cd varchar2(5);
 c_don_typ varchar2(5);
 c_last_name varchar2(50); 
 c_middle_name varchar2(50);
 c_first_name varchar2(50); 
 c_ssn varchar2(15);
 c_date_of_birth date;
 c_abo varchar2(5);
 term_cnt number :=0;
 chk_all number :=0;
begin
 begin
 select donation_type,
 procedure_code,
 drive_id,
 donor_id,
 donor_cue
 into c_don_typ,
 c_proc_cd,
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_cue
 from donations
 where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;

 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('18034'); /* Error retrieving Donor Information */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 begin 
 select first_name,
 middle_name,
 last_name,
 decode(gender,'M','Male','F','Female'),
 date_of_birth,
 nvl(blood_type,'NONE')
 into c_first_name,
 c_middle_name,
 c_last_name,
 :ctrl_block_1.sex,
 c_date_of_birth,
 c_abo
 from donors
 where donor_id = :ctrl_block_1.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18034'); /* Error retrieving Donor Information */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 
 --Change made by Kishore on 09/12/2008 to accomodate the 4 digit SSN
 /*if c_ssn is not null then
 if length(c_ssn) <= 4 then
 c_ssn := lpad(c_ssn, 4, '0');
 elsif length(c_ssn) > 4 then
 c_ssn := substr(c_ssn, -4, 4);
 end if;
 c_ssn := '00000' || c_ssn;
 end if;*/
 -- End of change

 :ctrl_block_1.date_of_birth := to_char(c_date_of_birth,'MM-DD-YYYY');
 
 
 :ctrl_block_1.name := ltrim(rtrim(c_last_name))||', '||ltrim(rtrim(c_first_name))||' '||
 ltrim(rtrim(c_middle_name));
 
 begin
 select description
 into :ctrl_block_1.donation_type
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type = c_don_typ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18035'); /* Invalid donation type */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 begin
 select description
 into :ctrl_block_1.procedure
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = c_proc_cd;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('3122'); /* Invalid procedure */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 /* populate blood type */
 begin
 select substr(description,1,20)
 into :ctrl_block_1.blood_type
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='ABO'
 and code=nvl(c_abo,'NONE');
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11040'); /* Invalid Blood type */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 
 /* get other interdictions */
 begin
 select 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 and access_code_value ='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if chk_all=1 then
 :ctrl_block_1.other_inter := 0 ;
 else
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :ctrl_block_1.other_inter
 from donation_interdictions 
 where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER' 
 and access_class in (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) 
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(insert_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1); 

 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into term_cnt
 from donation_interdictions
 where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and inter_code in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) )
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and trunc(term_date)<trunc(sysdate);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if term_cnt > 0 then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.show_term','E');
 end if;
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 execute_query;
 go_block('new_inter_blk');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.colldate','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.transaction_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.d_deferral_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.d_dummy_deferral_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.r_or_d','D');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.save','E');
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.retrieve','D');
 end;

END;
